name: Single-arm low-cable lateral raise
_doc: Angles in degrees. Arm directions: abduct = out to the side from hanging, forward = how far the raise sits in front of the frontal plane (scaption). elbowFlex bends the elbow. Targets: AnatomyKit direction IDs; prime movers of `prime` directions are tinted strongly; prime movers of `secondary` directions and helpers of `prime` directions are tinted lightly. shoulderElevate lifts the shoulder girdle (clavicle and scapula) so the scapula rotates with the arm, roughly a third of the arm's elevation (scapulohumeral rhythm).

equipment._doc: Tower beside the body on the non-working side, pulley low and slightly forward (metres, body frame: +x body's left, +y forward, z up from the floor).
